name: Banana Blitz
card_quote: "I don't want to play CT. I prefer Boss Rush."
card_desc: → Banana Blitz is made just for you. A dedicated Boss Rush team focusing on beating all islands and getting rewards as fast as possible. Don't want to play and just get rewards? No problem — you can leave your team to grab rewards, and go back.
modal_quote: "I don't want to play CT. I prefer Boss Rush."
modal_desc: Banana Blitz is our dedicated Boss Rush team, built for fast island clears and getting everyone their rewards as quickly as possible. You don't even need to actively play — once the team clears all islands, you can collect the free rewards without having contributed a single attack. Already on a CT team? You can switch over to Blitz for Boss Rush events and back again — no strings attached.
requirements: Active during Boss Rush events — be present when the event runs
No CT requirement — this team exists purely for Boss Rush
CT players welcome — if you also play CT, you can freely switch between teams per event
Not playing? No problem — you can still collect rewards after the team clears all islands
